title: Global-sections factorization before affine stalk localization
statement: For commutative rings A,B, a ring map phi:A to B, a cochain complex M of A-modules, an isomorphism e from Q(tilde(M)) to a derived object K, an invertible ordinary-to-derived pullback counit at M, and an integer i, the forward map of the affine base-change cohomology coordinate [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates] equals tilde.isoTop(H^i(B tensor M)), followed by global sections of the composite of [new-def-pc-affine-tensor-pullback-homology-sheaf-iso], homology of the inverse counit, and homology of derived pullback of e. There is no prime, localization or stalk, and no quasi-coherence hypothesis on the final object.

source.place: Tag 01I9 affine tilde comparison; coordinate construction of Tag 0DJ8

proof.text: Expand the existing global coordinate. The inverse exact tilde homology map, inverse derived homology factorization and inverse termwise tensor comparison are the named sheaf isomorphism. For the remaining factors use Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom and Functor.mapIso_inv; use Functor.map_comp and associativity to identify the composite forward map. The leading tilde.isoTop is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso and affineTensorPullbackHomologySheafIso; Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.map_comp and Category.assoc

lean.statement:
theorem affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso_globalSections_factorization
    (A A' : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φg' : A →+* A')
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ K)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) (i : ℤ) :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φg').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace)) i
    let d := affineTensorPullbackHomologySheafIso A A' φg' M i
    let c := inv ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso A A' φg' K M e hc i).hom =
      (tilde.isoTop (R := .of A') (C.homology i)).hom ≫
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A')).map
          (d.hom ≫ H.map c ≫
            H.map ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).map e.hom))
